If you want meaningful work, visible impact and put something genuinely rare on your CV, keep reading.

About the role:

We're hiring for Self-Managed Experience (SMX) - the team responsible for making Camunda 8 deployable in a self-service way for customers who run their own infrastructure. SMX covers two areas of work: installation artifacts (Helm chart, Docker Compose, C8Run) and reference architectures & cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, Azure).

This role sits primarily on the installation artifacts side - building, maintaining, and releasing the artifacts that ship Camunda 8 to every self-managed customer. You'll be fully embedded in that area day-to-day, but you'll work alongside the reference-architecture side of the team regularly, and SMX is actively working toward enabling every engineer to review and contribute across both stacks over time.

SMX is also shifting from a purely artifact- and ops-focused team toward one in which engineers bring customer judgment and product sense alongside technical depth. That means engaging directly with the teams closest to customers - Support, Consulting, Presales - and using that signal to help shape what we prioritize, not just executing a fully-specced ticket.

You'll find plenty of room to leave your own footprint: deployment automation, software and infrastructure testing, multi-region setups, and developer experience are all live areas of investment as the team matures from "basic install" toward full-lifecycle ownership (upgrades, backup/restore, disaster recovery).

Curious about the kind of challenges you'll work on at Camunda? Watch this quick 30-minute talk https://www.camundacon.com/event-session/camundacon-amsterdam-2025/one-exporter-to-rule-them-all-exploring-camunda-exporter/?on_demand=true from our engineers to learn more about the new Camunda Exporter and how we’re solving complex problems at scale

What You’ll Be Doing:

-  Build, maintain, and release C8 distribution artifacts for self-managed customers - Helm Charts (Kubernetes), C8Run, and Docker Compose - along with their documentation.

- Improve the reliability and usability of deployment artifacts across the full customer lifecycle: installation, upgrades, and day-2 operations, not just initial deployment.

- Engage directly with internal customer-facing teams (Support, Consulting, Presales) to understand real deployment problems, and use that signal to help shape what gets prioritized - not just how it gets built. Collaborate with Development Teams, Product Management, QA, and Documentation to ship integrated, tested, and documented releases.

title: Content LiveOps Manager
description:
We've set the standard in kids entertainment.
Come help us raise it.
We're Lingokids , the #1 entertainment platform for young kids. Most kids content is designed to capture attention. We create experiences little ones genuinely love.
Everything we make is created in-house to be seriously fun, with the good stuff built in from the very beginning. We're KidSAFE certified, completely ad-free, and committed to giving families entertainment they can trust, with no compromise. Ever.
20 million kids come back to us every single month, and we’ve earned more than 50 awards along the way. Now we're going after something bigger: becoming the go-to entertainment destination for kids everywhere, and changing what content looks like for the generation growing up on it.
You in? Keep on reading.
What you’ll do
As a Content LiveOps Manager , you will build Content LiveOps from (almost) zero: there's limited live-ops cadence and an early playbook, so what you set up becomes the operating rhythm Lingokids ship from here on. There's a lot to unlock too. As we grow into the leading kids' entertainment platform for licensed IPs, every new IP adds another vein of live-ops potential (events, drops, tie-ins) nobody's tapped yet.

• You’ll own and run a weekly content release cadence: new games, new IPs, new content going live on a predictable schedule.

• Design, plan and run time-limited events as the program matures, eg: a themed weekend drop with its own promotional treatment, not just a content update.

• Define what a release needs beyond the content itself: teaser moments, custom or animated icons, countdown treatments, in-app announcements, comms, and work with marketing, engineering and design to build what makes that possible.

• Soft-launch new content and games, and own the process for how something moves from ready to live.

• Partner with the Content Experimentation team to test the variables that matter (event length, timing, locking, positioning, packaging) and use the results to improve the next release.

• Be accountable for whether releases actually land: on schedule, and with a measurable lift in engagement and retention.

What you’ll bring

• Direct experience running a content release cadence, live-ops strategy, or live-events pipeline, done operationally.

• Comfort with a weekly operating rhythm.

• Strong cross-functional coordination skills: you'll be pulling in engineering, art, and design capacity shared across a broader team, not a dedicated build team of your own.

• LiveOps and Performance Data literacy: you can look at a release's performance and know whether it worked, how to iterate, and why.

• Background in games where "what's live changes constantly" is a normal part of the job.

Nice to have.

• Experience specifically with time-limited or seasonal events (eg: a holiday tie-in, a licensed-IP drop, a themed weekend…)

• Familiarity with subscription or content platforms for a young or family audience.

English is a must: We’re a multicultural team providing a service in English , so while certifications aren’t necessary, fluency is essential. As a fully remote company, clear and effective spoken and written communication -especially in asynchronous, long-form formats-is key to collaborating successfully.
Life at Lingokids
📚 Career Growth: Your growth drives our success! We invest in your development up to €2,000 per year for books and training; so you can keep learning and growing with us.
🏡 Remote in Spain & Relocation-Friendly Work from wherever you’re most productive, whether that’s your home anywhere in Spain or our vibrant hub in Madrid . Not currently in Spain? We’d love to have you here! We actively encourage relocation for those looking to make Spain their new home base.
📈 Stock Options: Your contribution matters! You'll receive stock options , giving you the opportunity to own part of the company and share in its success.
🖥 Home Office Setup: Create your ideal workspace with a €400 allowance for setup

Our mission is The Utility of Compute™: AI infrastructure as dependable and available as electricity, for every organization that needs it. Launched with a $10B strategic partnership with one of the leading frontier AI labs, a Series A led by Andreessen Horowitz, and a $5B AI Infrastructure Fund, Volta is building the infrastructure layer of the AI era from the ground up. Reporting to the VP of Accounting, this is a hands-on, builder role: you will design the forecasting and reporting cadence from scratch, in an environment where capital deployment is large, fast, and lumpy - data center build-outs, GPU procurement, colocation deployments, and project financing. This is not a classic long-range planning seat. What You Will Be Doing Own the rolling 13-week cash flow forecast across all group entities and currencies (GBP, USD, EUR, NOK), including AP outflows, payroll, project payments, and intercompany

title: Licensed Marriage and Family Therapist (LMFT) - Methuen, MA
description:
Licensed Marriage and Family Therapist (LMFT) $70 K-85K/yr

Position Requirement: Remote Full-Time and Part-time Positions Available

If you are looking for a new opportunity to grow with a clinician founded and clinician led organization, look no further! As an authentic, unique, and skilled counselor, you have a plethora of options when it comes to work. Hospitals, community clinics, investment bank funded group practice startups, state agencies, and more.

At OptiMindHealth , we continuously strive to provide consistent, high-quality care and expand the reach of mental health care services in our communities. Unfortunately, the need often outpaces the services available to those we serve and only adds to the current mental health crisis in our nation. To combat this crisis and further our mission, we need more compassionate and skilled clinicians to join our cause. We are not interested in the “burnt-out” clinician that no longer finds meaning in their work and is just going through the motions; we are seeking people with a passion to provide excellent care, and the belief that we, together, can make a difference. If that’s you, then you’re in the right place!

Our approach with our team is simple, we take care of you, the clinician, so you can take care of patients. How do we do that? By investing in your growth, supporting you financially, holistically, and professionally, while being flexible regarding your personal needs and goals. The work we do with patients is hard enough and over the years we have found that our team often does their best work when the administrative burdens are taken off their plate and they are able to be fully present with their patients. Our administrative support team handles all non-clinical tasks so that you don’t have to think about anything except focusing on your patients.

Why bother with the endless administrative burdens and isolation of private practice? Use your highly trained interpersonal skills to change the culture around mental health care, decrease stigma, and help people who need you, while being supported by an experienced multi-disciplinary team of clinicians. Let us take care of the rest!

Want to work part time? No problem. Want to do group therapy? Sure! Want to do long-term psychodynamic psychotherapy with all of your clients? We do it every day. Interested in treating couples? We can make that happen. Basically, what we are saying is that whatever outpatient care you are interested in providing, we can surely accommodate you. We know you have exceptional skills; we want you to be part of our team.

The perfect candidate will share our passion for improving and expanding access to high quality mental health care and will thrive in a culture that emphasizes creativity, authenticity, humor, compassion, acceptance, and determination. Telehealth or onsite, we support your authentic and unique growth trajectory, while being yourself and having some fun!

We prioritize the clinician's experience by offering excellent compensation, benefits, training/supervision, and flexibility. Whether you’re working from home or in one of our physical offices, if you’re doing it during your scheduled work hours, you’re getting paid for it. Our compensation packages include:

• Starting Salary range: $70,000.00 - $85,000.00 per year.

• 401K with maximum employee matching.

• Health care benefits.

• Generous paid vacation and sick leave time.

• Paid administrative time for consultation, supervision, and documentation.

• Full administrative support.

Here are a few extra perks our team loves:

• Paid supervision, clinical rounds, and administrative time.

• Customized schedules within available clinic hours.

• Hybrid work environment if desired: Telehealth and/or in-person (in select locations).

• Muti-disciplinary team approach to treatment.

• Incredible administrative support team.

• Company leadership that understands the practice of mental healthcare.

title: Strategic Account Executive, Corporate
Counsellor - 1800RESPECT
description:
Transform Digital Healthcare with Telstra Health

At Telstra Health , we’re shaping the future of healthcare through connected solutions that make care safer, faster and more seamless.
From digital health platforms to trusted social support programs like 1800RESPECT, the Leaving Violence Program and the National Cancer Screening Register, our work helps improve lives at scale.
Join us to do meaningful work where purpose, innovation and real-world impact come together every day.
About 1800RESPECT
Telstra Health proudly delivers the 1800RESPECT Service. This is the national 24/7 domestic, family and sexual violence counselling, information, and support service.
1800RESPECT provides free, confidential support for people experiencing, or at risk of experiencing, domestic, family, and sexual violence, including workplace sexual harassment. The Service also provides support for friends, family, and professionals.
About the role
As a First Response Counsellor in these part-time or full-time positions, you'll provide trauma-informed support via phone, video, web chat, and SMS in a fast-paced contact centre environment.
What you'll be doing

• Conducting risk and safety assessments

• Providing counselling, information, referrals, and support

• Connecting people with appropriate services and pathways to safety

• What you'll bring to the role

• Strong understanding of domestic, family, sexual violence, and sexual assault practices

• Experience working in trauma-informed and person-centred frameworks

• Proven ability to navigate multiple systems and applications such as Microsoft Teams and CRM platforms

• Demonstrated experience in providing high levels of support and care to service users

• A suitable private, confidential, distraction free workspace

• A non-satellite 5G or NBN internet connection

• Minimum internet speeds of 50Mbps download and 20Mbps upload

• A hard-wired internet connection using Ethernet or Powerline adapters, as Wi-Fi is not supported

About you

• You'll hold a relevant bachelor’s qualification (minimum three years) that meets professional registration requirements

• You'll hold a current registration with, or be eligible for registration with one of the following:

• PACFA - Clinical Registration

• ACA - Level 3 or above

• AASW - Full Membership

• AHPRA - General Registration as a Psychologist

• You'll have at least three years’ full-time counselling experience post qualification

• A current Working with Children Check

• Availability to complete 2 weeks of full-time onboarding prior to commencement

About Us
Enjoy the flexibility to work from home, opportunities to shape a roster that works for you, and the option to earn additional income through overtime when available.
Flexibility isn't a perk - it’s how we work! Love solving meaningful problems in an innovative, evolving environment? You’ll fit right in! At Telstra Health , your work is impactful, your growth is supported, and your ideas are heard.
By joining our team of health and tech experts, you’ll learn, grow, and make a real-world difference.
Perks & Benefits

• Free Telstra mobile & plan (eligible employees only)

• 25% off Telstra products & services

• 16 weeks paid gender-equal parental leave + extra leave options

• Career breaks, study support & ongoing learning programs

• Free 24/7 professional support for you & your family

• Employee rewards program: discounts on shopping, gyms, movies, health insurance & more

We’re committed to inclusion. Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander people, individuals from all backgrounds, and those living with or caring for someone with a disability are encouraged to apply. Even if you don’t tick every box, we want to hear from you.
We’re a Circle Back Initiative Employer-you’ll get a response for every application.
Apply today to join a team that’s making a real difference in healthcare.
Learn more about how Telstra Health is improving lives through digitally-enabled care here.

title: Manager, Pricing and Packaging
description:
As the most trusted global leader in data-first contract lifecycle management (CLM) software, Agiloft helps organizations manage the end-to-end process of proposing, negotiating, signing, and leveraging contracts using our flexible Data-first Agreement Platform (DAP). With contract data as the foundation, customers quickly and collaboratively reach agreement and leverage contract visibility to thrive with competitive advantage. Employing powerful, pragmatic artificial intelligence as a legal force multiplier, and robust integration capabilities as a data liberator, organizations around the world trust Agiloft’s certified implementers to deliver connected, intelligent, and autonomous solutions across the entire contract lifecycle.

Top analysts like Gartner, Forrester, and IDC agree, all showing Agiloft as a leader in the CLM space. Our no code platform is easily managed and administered by business users, which is why Agiloft is the contract you keep: nearly a full 100% of new customers are satisfied with their initial implementations, and some 97% of customers renew every year. Ours is a growing, vibrant, successful company that is at the forefront of a market that is becoming a must-have for all organizations.

We believe that the way to build the strongest, most vibrant place to work is to bring in individuals from all walks of life, and to support them in bringing their authentic selves to their day, every day. Our working philosophy is that “EX = CX”: when employee experience is excellent, so is customer experience. We support multiple Employee Resource Groups (ERGs), and offer a working environment that supports healthy work/life balance, including floating holidays and a quarterly, no-questions-asked wellness day.

Position Overview
Agiloft is building new paths to monetize the value it creates, including new consumption and outcome-based models, and we need dedicated ownership of the analytical and operational engine behind that work. The Manager, Pricing & Packaging will be responsible for developing and putting forward the recommendations to the pricing committee for review and approval regarding pricing research, model design(s), packaging analysis, and monetization experiments that directly inform how Agiloft goes to market.
 
This role sits within the Product organization, reporting to the Director of Product GTM, and works in close partnership with Finance, Sales, Revenue Operations, and Product. You are the person who turns pricing questions into frameworks and frameworks into decisions that deliver customer solutions as transactable units of value that serve them and grow our business. You will build the quantitative foundation that allows Agiloft to deploy pricing as a strategic capability across functional boundaries.

Ensuring a diverse and inclusive workplace is our priority. We are committed to an environment of acceptance where you are free to bring your full self to work. All employment decisions at Agiloft are based on business needs, job requirements, and individual qualifications without regard to race, color, religion or belief, national or social ethnic origin, sex, age, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, parental status, marital status, Veteran status, or any other status protected by the laws or regulations in the locations where we operate. If you have a need that requires accommodation during the recruiting process, please let us know by contacting Director, Talent Acquisition, Brad Toothman at brad.toothman@agiloft.com.

AI-generated content is moving from experimentation to production. The challenge is no longer generation-it’s control, reliability, and scale.

Hercules founding team works in-office in San Francisco (Kearny and Bush). We have a very strong preference for in office. We are open to remote for exceptional candidates who are willing to 1) work in US time zones and 2) travel to the office regularly.

To become the car-changing destination of choice. By combining technology, media and deep automotive expertise, we've turned how people buy, sell, advertise and lease cars on its head.

What started as a simple reviews site is now one of the largest online car-changing destinations in Europe. Last year alone we grew over 50% with nearly £3bn worth of cars bought on site, while £1.8bn of cars were listed for sale through our Sell My Car service.

In 2024 we went big and acquired Autovia - creators of AutoExpress and Evo magazines - doubling our audience overnight. Together we now have one of the biggest YouTube https://www.youtube.com/carwow channels in the world with almost 10m subscribers and over 1.1 billion annual views, while we sell 1.2 million print copies of our magazines and have an annual web content reach over 350million.

And we’re a long way from done!

THE ROLE

We're looking for a Senior Data Scientist to join our award-winning Data Science team at a pivotal moment. Carwow operates a two-sided marketplace - connecting car buyers and sellers at scale - and data science sits at the heart of how we make that marketplace smarter, faster, and more valuable for everyone in it. In fact, we recently won GenAI initiative of the Year at the British Data Awards.

This is a hands-on, high-ownership role working centrally across the business. You'll partner with teams spanning Commercial, Marketing, Product, Finance, Engineering and Operations - developing and deploying ML and AI solutions that drive outcomes across both sides of our marketplace. The problems you'll work on are genuinely varied: pricing models, propensity and demand signals that sharpen marketing spend, personalised recommendations for our web product and CRM, and LLM-powered solutions for operational challenges like document verification.

You'll translate ambiguous business problems into structured, production-ready solutions - and you'll be expected to deliver them end-to-end, from first principles through to being deployment-ready and beyond.

 

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

- End-to-End ML & AI Delivery: Lead data science initiatives from problem framing through to deployment, monitoring, and iteration - delivering the full production lifecycle. With no dedicated ML engineering function, you'll be responsible for ensuring your solutions are robust, scalable, and performing in the real world long after they ship.

- GenAI & LLM Application: Design and build LLM-powered solutions where they create genuine business value - document processing, intelligent search, content understanding, and beyond. Apply them alongside classical ML with clear judgement about where each approach earns its place.

- Commercial Impact: Connect your work directly to business outcomes. Whether you're building a model to improve marketing efficiency, a pricing signal to sharpen commercial decisions, or a recommendation engine to increase conversion - you understand the business lever you're pulling and design your solutions accordingly.

- Prototyping & Experimentation: Move fast to test ideas before committing to full-scale development. Define rigorous success metrics upfront, validate honestly, and know when to double down and when to walk away.

- Cross-Functional Partnership: Work closely with Commercial, Marketing, Product, Finance, Engineering and Operations stakeholders to understand problems deeply before reaching for a solution. Translate findings into clear, actionable narratives for both technical and non-technical audiences.

- Standards & Craft: Contribute to shared best practices, documentation, and ways of working that raise the bar for the data science function - and help more junior team members grow alongside you. Drive continued adoption of AI capabilities to drive efficiencies, automation and constantly leverage new capabilities.

title: Enquêteur ou enquêteuse en situation de crise communautaire
description:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

La communauté que vous rejoindrez :
Les enquêteurs en situation de crise communautaire constituent la première ligne d’intervention d’Airbnb face aux incidents les plus graves touchant notre communauté : menaces de violence, escalades en matière de sécurité et événements qui exposent les voyageurs, les hôtes ou l’entreprise à des risques importants. Dans ce rôle, vous ferez le lien entre un incident et les personnes et ressources capables de le résoudre, puis vous veillerez à l’exécution complète des mesures approuvées, afin que le préjudice causé à notre communauté cesse le plus tôt possible.

La différence que vous ferez :
À titre d’enquêteur ou d’enquêteuse en situation de crise communautaire, vous allez gérer votre propre charge de dossiers et dirigez l’intervention au quotidien, avec un point de validation défini pour les décisions qui créent un précédent ou comportent une exposition publique. Vous évaluez les incidents et partagez avec l’équipe ce que vous avez appris.

Une journée type :

Traitement des dossiers de crise

• Évaluer les incidents entrants et recommander si un dossier atteint le seuil de mise en œuvre du protocole de crise, en rédigeant des résumés assez concis et complets pour que le décideur puisse agir sans avoir à les retourner pour obtenir des précisions.

• Définir et piloter les mesures de gestion de dossiers nécessaires pour que les parties prenantes puissent intervenir efficacement, en respectant l’échéancier de l’incident.

• Rechercher les précédents et consulter les parties prenantes lorsqu’un dossier ne correspond pas à un modèle établi, et présenter l’option recommandée avec son raisonnement plutôt qu’une question ouverte.

• Préparer des aperçus concis et les prochaines étapes pour les dossiers urgents, sous surveillance ou activés, et signaler les mises à jour d’équipe ou les points administratifs lors des rencontres régionales.

Communication et gestion des parties prenantes

• Rédiger les communications relatives aux dossiers de crise destinées aux parties prenantes de haut niveau, et fournir les détails du dossier et l’évaluation sur lesquels reposent les notes d’information à la direction.

• Tenir les parties prenantes et la direction de la gestion mondiale des crises (Global Crisis Management, GCM) au courant de l’état des dossiers de façon proactive, avant même qu’elles ne le demandent.

• Assurer la communication quotidienne avec vos partenaires interfonctionnels attitrés : maintenir un contact régulier, vous présenter aux rencontres préparé, avec un ordre du jour établi et transmettre à l’équipe mondiale de la GCM ce que vous apprenez.

Amélioration systémique

• Signaler les cas où une politique, un produit ou un processus a fait défaut à un membre de la communauté, avec suffisamment de précision pour que l’équipe responsable puisse agir. L’objectif est de combler la lacune qui a permis l’incident, et pas seulement de résoudre l’incident.

title: Senior Full-Stack Angular / NodeJS Web Developer - Full Remote - Contractor
Revenue Accounting Manager
description:
ABOUT LIVEKIT

LiveKit is building the infrastructure layer for the voice-driven era of computing. Our platform gives developers everything they need to build, test, deploy, scale, and observe agents in production. Founded in 2021, LiveKit powers voice AI applications for OpenAI, xAI, Salesforce, Coursera, Spotify, and thousands of others, collectively facilitating billions of calls each year.

ABOUT YOU

Our revenue is credit-denominated and consumption-based - usage billing, prepaid credit drawdown, and concurrency pricing across a growing enterprise base - which is close to the most complex revenue profile in infrastructure software. The load-bearing questions are open and there are few set policies and processes.

You will be the technical authority on revenue. You will own the entire Order to Cash cycle, from interfacing with our sales team, reviewing contracts, assessing terms in accordance with ASC 606, implementing workpapers and schedules, documenting conclusions, and assisting with billing and collection efforts. If building processes from square one and taking ownership of some of the most complex revenue arrangements excites you, this is the role for you.

You'll thrive as a Revenue Accounting Manager if you:

- are obsessed with making the best product for our customers

- are known as the go-to person for tackling tough problems

- work hard and can build and ship fast

- are focused on polish, detail and quality

- are a fast learner, frequently picking up new tips, tricks, and skills

The best way to impress us is with thoughtful ways you'd implement LiveKit, and potentially tinkering with it 😊

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Author our revenue accounting policy set - principal versus agent on brokered inference, breakage on expiring credits, performance obligation identification and allocation, minimum commitment versus overage, and contract modifications - and make each one stand up to an external auditor

- Own the monthly revenue close: recognition, the deferred revenue rollforward, contract asset and liability balances, and the flux analysis

- Own the revenue portion of our external audit, from the PBC list through the technical positions

- Replace manual revenue entries with an automated billing-to-revenue reconciliation and a documented exception process - revenue should be computed by a system and reviewed by a person, with invoice accuracy above 99% and root-cause tracking on the misses

- Govern order to cash: billing accuracy, dispute resolution, and an AR and collections process with real DSO and aging targets

- Own commission capitalization and amortization under ASC 340-40

- Review non-standard deal structures before they're signed, so the accounting consequence is a decision rather than a discovery

WHO YOU ARE

- You're a licensed CPA with a Big 4 or comparable technical accounting foundation, plus real industry experience in a high-growth startup environment

- You have demonstrable ASC 606 experience with usage-based or consumption revenue

- You write technical memos that a reviewer can follow without a meeting: facts, guidance, analysis, conclusion

- Experience assessing GAAP guidance and implementing it in real-world situations

- You've owned a monthly revenue close hands-on, and you've closed revenue through at least one external audit

- You're comfortable being the technical authority without a bench behind you

NICE TO HAVE

- Billing system implementation or migration - Metronome, Stripe, Zuora

- Pre-IPO or first-audit experience

- Enough SQL to validate a recognition schedule against raw usage data yourself

OUR COMMITMENT TO YOU

- An opportunity to build something truly impactful to the world

- Contribute to open source alongside world-class engineers

- Competitive salary and equity package

- Health, dental, and vision benefits

- Flexible vacation policy

LiveKit is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any characteristic protected by applicable law

description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. The Corporate Technical team is responsible for building and optimizing the many systems and internal technologies that enable Anduril to accomplish its mission. Anduril’s supply chain, accounting, sales & growth, field maintenance, manufacturing, and many more teams rely on the technology built and maintained by us. We call this system-of-systems “CorpOS”. Within CorpOS lies a suite of digital software solutions aimed at solving the problems for our growth, finance, people teams that interplays heavily with our ArsenalOS solutions that enable Anduril’s engineering, production and sustainment departments.

ABOUT THE JOB

We're building the financial systems backbone that lets a fast-scaling manufacturing company move with the speed of a software startup and the rigor of a public company. As Finance Solutions Manager, you'll sit at the intersection of Finance, Operations, and Engineering-owning the platforms, data, and processes that turn raw operational activity into trustworthy financial insight. This is a builder's role:

•  Establish standards for change management, testing, and documentation so the platform stays clean as the team scales

•  Act as the bridge between Finance and Engineering/Data teams, ensuring technical decisions reflect real accounting and operational needs

•  Mentor analysts and set the bar for how finance systems work gets done

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:

•  Demonstrated experience designing and implementing finance solutions end to end-requirements through deployment and adoption-not just administering existing systems

•  Strong grounding in accounting fundamentals: general led

title: Praktikum im Bereich Fundraising/Veranstaltungen
description:
Du hast Lust auf ein Praktikum, bei dem du dich für den Klimaschutz einsetzen kannst? Du willst gerne in das Fundraising einer gemeinnützigen Organisation reinschnuppern und hast Spaß an der Organisation und Durchführung von Veranstaltungen? Du hast 3 Monate Zeit? Super! Dann melde dich bei uns! Wir suchen insbesondere von Februar bis April eine:n Praktikant:in im Bereich Veranstaltungsorganisation für unser jährliches Frühlingsfest.
Mögliche Aufgaben:

• Du unterstützt das Fundraising-Team in allen relevanten Aspekten der Veranstaltungsplanung, -durchführung und -nachbereitung.

• Du übernimmst das Einladungsmanagement und kümmerst dich um die Kommunikation mit den eingeladenen Unterstützer:innen.

• Du übernimmst Rechercheaufgaben zu relevanten Themen, z.B. eine passende Location oder spannenden Speaker:innen.

• Du bereitest passende Texte für die Akquise von Catering, Speaker:innen, etc vor und übernimmst die Kommunikation.

• Du bist kreativ und bereitest Grafiken (Einladungen, Programme, etc.) auf Canva für anstehende Veranstaltungen vor.

• Du bist am Tag der Veranstaltung vor Ort und kümmerst dich um die von dir vorbereiteten Bereiche.

• Du hast noch weitere Ideen, wie wir unsere Veranstaltungen für unsere Unterstützer:innen so spannend wie möglich machen können? Super, wir freuen uns über deinen Input!

• Wenn du darüber hinaus Lust hast, in weitere Fundraising-Themen reinzuschnuppern, hast du dazu in unserem Team ebenfalls die Gelegenheit.

• Du hast ein hohes Interesse an Event-Management und allen Phasen der Organisation und Durchführung von Veranstaltungen (digital und vor Ort).

• Du bist sicher und schnell im Erstellen von Texten.

• Du bist kommunikationsfreudig und gehst gerne auf Menschen zu.

• Du hast erste Erfahrungen im Umgang mit Spender:innen gemacht oder bringst sehr viel Lust mit, dich in das Thema Fundraising einzuarbeiten.

• Du bist ein:e Teamplayer:in und arbeitest selbstständig und strukturiert. Du erkennst kritische Grenzen, bei denen du nach Unterstützung oder Feedback fragst.

• Dir liegt der Klimaschutz am Herzen und du hast richtig viel Lust, anderen Menschen das Thema näher zu bringen.

• Du willst Menschen zeigen, wie wichtig das Engagement durch Spenden für gemeinnützige Organisationen ist.

Achtung: Das Praktikum ist nicht vergütet. Wir arbeiten daran, zukünftig Praktikant:innen zumindest eine Aufwandsentschädigung bezahlen zu können. Sobald das eine Option ist, werden wir diesen Text hier anpassen.
Remote-Arbeit ist möglich. Idealerweise suchen wir für diese Stelle eine Person, die in Berlin lebt oder sich vorstellen kann, regelmäßig nach Berlin zu kommen, da es sich vor allem um die Unterstützung bei einer Veranstaltung in vor Ort handelt.
Haben wir dich neugierig gemacht? Dann werde Zeronaut:in und arbeite gemeinsam mit uns am Ziel, das Pariser Klimaversprechen einzuhalten und Deutschland mit konkreten Lösungen klimaneutral zu machen. Wir - das ist ein gut gemischtes Team von Berufseinsteiger:innen und Berufserfahrenen, die sowohl aus NGOs und Start-ups, als auch aus Konzernen kommen. Was wir schätzen, sind Vielfalt und Offenheit, Professionalität, Tatkraft und Effizienz und vor allem den Antrieb, die Klimakrise nicht weiter eskalieren zu lassen. Denn was uns alle eint, ist der unbedingte Wille, unser Ziel zu erreichen.
Bitte sende uns einen Lebenslauf und ein Anschreiben zu, aus dem Deine Motivation deutlich wird.
GermanZero e.V. ist eine führende Klimaschutzorganisation, die sich einem großen Ziel verschrieben hat: Wir machen Deutschland bis 2035 klimaneutral. Wir sind an der Schnittstelle von Wissenschaft, Politik und Zivilgesellschaft tätig und setzen dabei auf innovative Strategien und dynamische Kollaboration, um nachhaltige Veränderungen zu bewirken. Mit konstruktiven Lösungsangeboten wollen wir die Umsetzung einer effektiven Klimapolitik vorantreiben.

About Grafana Labs: 

There are more than 700,000 active installations of Grafana around the globe, monitoring everything from beehives to climate change in the Alps. The instantly recognizable dashboards have been spotted everywhere from a SpaceX launch and Minecraft HQ to Wimbledon and the Tour de France. Grafana Labs also helps companies including Bloomberg, JPMorgan Chase, and eBay manage their observability strategies with full-stack offerings that can be run fully managed with Grafana Cloud, or self-managed with Grafana Enterprise Stack. The Grafana stack has grown to include more open-source projects, including Grafana Loki (for logs) and Grafana Tempo (for traces) and Grafana Mimir (for metrics).

We’re looking for a Staff Technical Writer to create documentation and learning content that helps people adopt and master Grafana’s observability products. You’ll work with engineers, product managers, and the Grafana writing team to produce content for a range of products and audiences, from first-time users to experienced practitioners. Because our products and priorities evolve, we’re looking for someone who learns new technical domains quickly.

Key Responsibilities

• Plan, research, write, and maintain documentation and learning content (concepts, tasks, tutorials, references, and in-product learning) that supports adoption and long-term product mastery.

• Use AI tools and workflows to work faster and at a higher quality: drafting, structuring, technical validation, consistency checks, and keeping content current. You apply human judgment to everything AI produces and take responsibility for its accuracy.

• Contribute to the team’s shared AI workflows and skills, and look for ways to improve and automate how we create and maintain content as tools and models evolve.

• Partner with engineers, PMs, and other stakeholders to understand product requirements, interview subject matter experts, and turn complex technical detail into clear, accurate content.

• Test what you document. Run the software, follow your own procedures, and flag product and UX gaps you find along the way.

• Let data guide your priorities. We have strong docs and learning analytics. You’ll use them, along with user feedback, to find content gaps, prioritize your work, and show the impact of what you ship.

description:

We quickly earned a reputation for solving tough data challenges. Today, we empower organizations to embrace transformation and leverage advanced technologies, including AI, to stay competitive. Why you:

Pythian sits at the intersection of data engineering, AI production, and managed services - helping enterprises turn data complexity into competitive advantage. With three decades of deep managed services heritage and strategic partnerships across the leading cloud and database technology ecosystems, we are at the forefront of helping clients move from AI experimentation to AI in production.

We are looking for a polished, quota-carrying Sales Executive who is energized by the AI moment and knows how to help enterprise clients build the modern, well-managed data foundations that make production AI possible at scale. If you’re energized by the AI transformation happening across enterprise technology right now, know how to sell complex managed services, and want to represent a company with deep technical credibility and a growing AI practice - this role is built for you.

title: Senior Information Security Internal Auditor
description:
Everbridge helps enterprises and government organizations prepare for, respond to and recover from critical events. Its critical event management technology helps organizations reduce the impact of disruption, protect people and keep operations running.
We’re currently seeking a Senior Information Security Internal Auditor to join our team. This is a fully remote, home-based role open to candidates located anywhere in the United States.
What you'll do

• Develop and maintain the information security internal audit program within the Compliance portfolio, aligning it with FedRAMP, CMMC and other applicable requirements.

• Maintain Everbridge ’s Information Security and Privacy Framework, including its policies, procedures, standards and guidelines.

• Translate framework requirements into clear, testable technical controls and acceptance criteria that engineering teams can implement.

• Partner with Engineering, DevOps and Security to integrate effective controls into existing workflows.

• Own monthly continuous monitoring (ConMon) assessments and submissions.

• Coordinate with Engineering and Operations to deliver CMMC and FedRAMP documentation on time and meet project milestones.

• Serve as a technical point of contact during audits. Explain architecture, data flows and control evidence, and help auditors understand how requirements apply in a cloud environment.

• Represent Compliance in FedRAMP, CMMC and other certification projects and strategy discussions.

• Build and maintain automated evidence collection across cloud platforms, identity providers, CI/CD pipelines and ticketing systems.

• Develop policy-as-code and continuous control monitoring checks using tools such as OPA, Cloud Custodian or AWS Config.

• Own and improve the GRC platform and its integrations.

• Create audit plans and reports, maintain organized documentation and evidence, and establish clear processes and guidelines.

• Develop approaches for continuous monitoring and recertification, support external audits and assist with other audit activities as needed.

What you'll bring:

• At least three years of experience in security, assessments, compliance consulting or advisory work in a highly technical environment.

• At least three years of experience performing or supporting technical assessments for a major compliance effort, such as CMMC, FedRAMP, SOC 2, BSI C5 or ISO 27001.

• Experience with CMMC, DFARS, NIST SP 800-171, FedRAMP, NIST SP 800-53, FISMA or similar governance and compliance frameworks.

• Experience in cloud security, platform engineering or DevSecOps.

• Experience with Infrastructure as Code, such as Terraform, and integrating security tools into CI/CD pipelines.

• Strong understanding of information collection, reporting and documentation processes, including developing status reports, metrics and measures.

• Ability to explain technical risk to non-technical stakeholders and translate audit requirements for engineers, both verbally and in writing.

• Clear communication, strong organization and interpersonal skills, and the ability to take initiative and influence decision-makers.

• A CISSP, CIA, CISA, CySA+, CCSP or ISO 27001 Auditor certification is a plus.

• Must be a U.S. citizen and able to obtain a Secret clearance.

The reasonably estimated salary for this role at Everbridge ranges from $118,000 - $158,200 and may also include variable compensation. Actual compensation is based on factors such as the candidate's skills, qualifications, and experience. In addition, Everbridge offers a wide range of best in class, comprehensive and inclusive employee benefits for this role including healthcare, dental, parental planning, and mental health benefits, disability income benefits, life and AD&D insurance, a 401(k) plan and match, paid time off, and fitness reimbursements.

description:
Flex is building the AI-native private bank for business owners .
We’re re-architecting the entire financial system for entrepreneurs-from the first dollar a business earns to how that value compounds, moves, and is ultimately spent in real life. Banking, credit, payments, personal finance, and financial operations-rebuilt from the ground up as a single, intelligent system. Flex is the full financial home for ambitious owners.

Since launching publicly in September 2023 , Flex has scaled from zero to nine-figure annualized revenue , with a clear path to profitability by late 2026 . We move fast, ship relentlessly, and operate with extreme ownership.
Our customers are affluent business owners ($3-$200M in revenue) -the backbone of the economy and one of the most underserved segments in finance. They’re stuck with outdated banks and fragmented tools. We’re replacing all of it. The opportunity is massive: a ~$1T+ revenue market hiding in plain sight. Our ambition is to build a $100B+ company by delivering a product that is fundamentally better-not incrementally improved.

Flex has raised $100M+ in equity and $300M+ in debt.

- Mission-critical problems : We build software that directly controls how money moves at scale.

- High bar, low ego : Small teams, exceptional people, real ownership.

- Speed over comfort : We prioritize execution, quality, clarity, and results.

- Enduring impact : What we’re building will define how a generation of owners runs their businesses.
Team & Locations
We hire exceptional people who want to build hard things and see their work matter immediately. Roles are available in: San Francisco, Miami, New York, and fully remote.

Flex Fuels Ambition.

About the role

Flex moves real money at a serious scale, and someone has to make sure it only moves for the right reasons. We're hiring our first Financial Crimes Analysts to be that someone, and to build the function around them.

This is a net-new role. You'll report directly to the Head of Financial Crimes and work side by side with the people who designed our financial crime program. Once a customer is through the door, you own what happens next: monitoring their activity, investigating what looks wrong, deciding what is suspicious, and writing the narrative that backs the decision.

Your first priority will be working through our alert and case backlog and keeping the queue moving, which means a lot of hands-on investigation from day one. Our processes are still being built, so you'll also notice what's clunky, document it, and help simplify it. As the backlog comes under control, you'll have more room for bigger improvements. The scope is broader than a typical analyst role because the function is still taking shape, and the people who join first will set its standards and its reputation with our partners.

This is a strong fit if you have a few years of hands-on financial crimes experience, enjoy digging into cases, and want to grow from running a process into helping design one, with a clear path into broader program responsibilities as the team grows.

What you'll own

You'll be a core part of financial crime detection and investigation at Flex .

• Post-onboarding risk. Own the question "is this customer's activity legitimate?" from the moment an alert fires to the moment it is cleared, escalated, or filed.

• The queue and the backlog. Your first priority is working through our alert backlog and keeping the queue current, with an eye on both quality and speed, so real risk gets the scrutiny it deserves and good customers aren't slowed down by noise.

• The investigation standard. Help set the bar for what a strong case narrative looks like here: clear, well supported, and defensible to a regulator or bank partner without a follow-up call.

• Detection coverage. Flag the typologies, patterns, and blind spots you see across cases and bring them to Risk, Operations, and Engineering, so they can become better rules and fewer false positives.

title: EPC Transmission Line Engineer
description:

And you won't be doing it alone in a corner: this team runs on close collaboration across engineering disciplines, with a PE mentor invested in helping you grow into the next stage of your career.

What You'll Be Doing:

•
Design & Analysis - Model and analyze transmission structures using PLS-CADD, PLS-POLE, and PLS-TOWER, applying NESC, ASCE, ACI, IEEE, and related standards

•
Project Development - Support projects from conceptual routing and engineering analysis through material procurement and construction-ready packages, through as-builts and project close-out

•
Cross-Discipline Collaboration - Work alongside designers and engineers from other disciplines, plus project management teams, to keep designs moving toward the field

•
Client Interface - Participate in client-facing project work, building the communication skills that set senior engineers apart

•
Technical Growth - Work under the direct guidance of a licensed PE, with increasing ownership of design decisions as your judgment develops

• Design and analyze steel, wood, concrete, or fiberglass transmission structures using PLS-POLE, including structure selection and loading verification

• Underbuild/joint-use or attachment analysis, when required

• Perform foundation design or analysis for direct-embed and drilled-pier structures in MFAD or LPILE

• Prepare construction packages, including creating the basis of design, plan and profiles, staking sheets, bill of materials, structure data sheets, alignment maps, stringing charts, steel packages, foundation drawings, etc.

• Coordinate with the Construction prime on material procurement, material specs, and constructability

• Perform conductor selection and EMF studies

• Attend field walks and constructability reviews as needed

• Support proposal/estimating efforts

What You Bring (Required Qualifications):

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Civil, Structural, Electrical, or Mechanical Engineering

• 4+ years of relevant experience in electric utility transmission line design with Bachelor's degree OR 3 years of relevant combined experience with a Master's degree

• Proficiency in both PLS-CADD and PLS-POLE

• Strong written and verbal communication skills

• Ability to work independently while staying plugged into a team

• Candidates must be located in the United States to be considered

Preferred Qualifications:

• Experience with TOWER

• EIT certification (or actively pursuing)

• Exposure to FAD, Mathcad, AutoCAD or MicroStation, LPILE, or GIS tools

• Familiarity with Bentley ProjectWise

Why This Team:

•
Mentorship that matters - direct PE supervision means real technical guidance, not just sign-offs

•
Room to grow - clear path toward independent design ownership, EIT/PE milestones, and eventually leading your own scopes

•
Genuine cross-training - early exposure to structural and construction considerations most engineers don't see until much later

•
Work that ships - your designs become physical infrastructure, not shelved deliverables

title: Senior Data Analyst, GTM Analytics - Austin TX (Hybrid)
description:
Luxury Presence is building the AI growth platform for real estate. Backed by Bessemer Venture Partners and other top investors, we're a Series C company that has hit $100M in annual recurring revenue. More than 90,000 real estate professionals, including over 30% of the WSJ Real Trends top 100 agents in the United States, use us to run and grow their business.

Why This Role Matters
Our GTM Analytics team owns the metrics that run the business for Sales, Marketing, and Client Success. We're past the phase of standing up basic reporting - we're now building a modern, agentic analytics practice, including Lighthouse, our internal BI-as-code platform, where dashboards, metrics, and semantic definitions live in version-controlled code rather than scattered across disconnected tools.
This role is a chance to shape that next chapter. You'll partner directly with Sales, Marketing, and CS leaders to answer their hardest questions about pipeline, funnel conversion, campaign performance, and retention, while helping build the infrastructure and AI-forward workflows that let the whole GTM org get trustworthy answers faster.
You'll report to our Senior Manager of Analytics and work in tight, two-week sprints alongside Analytics Engineering, so you'll see your work ship and get used - fast.
What You'll Do
GTM Analysis & Decision Support
Deliver decision-ready analysis across Sales, Marketing, and Client Success: pipeline health, funnel conversion, campaign and channel performance, cohort/retention, and GRR/NRR drivers.
Partner directly with Sales, Marketing, and CSM stakeholders to scope questions, frame recommendations, and see analysis through to a decision - not just a dashboard handoff.
Bring structure to ambiguous asks - translate a stakeholder's question into a clear, testable analytical approach.
Data Modeling & Quality
Build and maintain dbt models and marts for Sales, Marketing, and CS domains, with Salesforce as a core source system.
Own data quality and documentation for your domain: clear definitions, source-of-truth tables, and QA that stakeholders can trust without double-checking.
Lighthouse & Agentic Analytics

Note: Lighthouse is an active build, not a finished platform - you'll be shaping it, not just using it.
Push our analytics workflows toward agentic AI: using AI agents to accelerate analysis, automate recurring reporting, and cut down on manual, one-off dashboard requests.
Bring a point of view on where AI can replace manual analyst work versus where it can't - you should be as comfortable prompting and evaluating an agent as writing the SQL yourself.
How You'll Work
Operate in two-week sprints, planning and prioritizing your own backlog against team OKRs alongside your manager.
Give clear, proactive status updates to stakeholders rather than waiting to be asked.
What We're Looking For
Experience
5+ years in analytics/BI, with meaningful time supporting Sales, Marketing, or Customer Success functions at a fast-growing company. Staff-level candidates should bring deeper scope - larger or more ambiguous problems owned end-to-end, and a track record of setting technical direction, not just executing against it.
Expert SQL and hands-on dbt experience modeling GTM data.
Comfortable with Python for analysis and automation - this isn't a heavy ML/stats role, but you know how to script your way out of manual work.
Experience with Salesforce as a data source - you understand CRM objects, fields, and the quirks of modeling data.
Familiarity with a modern data stack: Fivetran or similar EL tooling, and a cloud warehouse (we run Snowflake; BigQuery experience also welcome).

title: Software Engineer, Infrastructure AI
description:

Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.

We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,700 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles https://www.airwallex.com/en-us/operating-principles to see it in full.

 

About the Team

Airwallex’s Infrastructure & Productivity team is on a mission to turn everyday software engineers into superheroes. The team builds and maintains the internal platforms, tooling, and CI/CD infrastructure that power Airwallex’s global engineering organization, serving hundreds of engineers across multiple offices and time zones.

The team is now pioneering a bold new direction: an AI agent ecosystem where goal-oriented agents continuously operate across every repository - automating infrastructure operations, incident response, database management, and DevOps workflows. Built on Quartermaster, our internal agent platform, these agents autonomously plan, reason, and execute multi-step tasks against real infrastructure. You will be joining at the ground floor of this initiative, building the intelligent systems that fundamentally change how infrastructure work gets done at Airwallex.

What You’ll Do

As a Senior Software Engineer on the Infrastructure AI team, you will design, build, and operate goal-oriented AI agents that automate SRE, DevOps, and DBA workflows across Airwallex’s global infrastructure. You won’t be doing operations work yourself - you’ll be building the AI systems that do it. Your agents will autonomously investigate incidents, provision infrastructure, manage databases, execute deployments, and handle the operational tasks that traditionally require human intervention.

You will work on top of Quartermaster, Airwallex’s internal agent platform, building domain-specific agents that interact with real infrastructure tooling (Kubernetes, Terraform, cloud APIs, databases, monitoring systems). This role requires you to think deeply about agent architecture - planning and reasoning loops, tool selection and execution, safety guardrails, human-in-the-loop escalation, and how to make autonomous systems reliable in production infrastructure environments.

This hybrid role is based in Seattle, WA.

Responsibilities

- Build goal-oriented infrastructure AI agents: Design and implement autonomous agents on the Quartermaster platform that handle SRE, DevOps, and DBA workflows - including incident investigation and remediation, infrastructure provisioning, deployment orchestration, database operations, and capacity management.

- Design agent architectures for safety and reliability: Build robust agent loops with planning, reasoning, tool-use, error recovery, and human-in-the-loop escalation. Infrastructure agents touch production systems - they must be safe, auditable, and predictable.

- Integrate agents with infrastructure tooling: Give agents the ability to interact with real systems - Kubernetes, Terraform, cloud APIs (AWS, GCP, Aliyun), monitoring/observability platforms, databases, and CI/CD pipelines - through well-designed tool interfaces.
